### Josiah’s Covenant Faithfulness
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/josiahs-covenant-faithfulness
Passage: 2 Kings 23:1-20
Points:
- Josiah spearheaded a comprehensive purge of idolatrous worship across Judah after recommitting to the Lord's covenant.
- The cleansing reached the temple itself, removing objects dedicated to Baal, the Asherah pole, and cult prostitution quarters.
- Josiah abolished child sacrifice at Topheth and destroyed Jeroboam's historic altar at Bethel in fulfillment of prophecy.
- He eliminated the pagan priests who led the people into false worship, aligning Judah with Mosaic law.
- Josiah's reforming zeal challenges modern believers to eliminate spiritual compromise and take God's worship seriously.
